attemptNotes: Initial nonce-race attempts used one unlocked signer concurrently and were inconclusive due to mempool nonce collisions.
Some fixture retries left queued transactions after EVM revert; the harness now clears the disposable mempool between checkpoints.
Synthetic QA EOAs use explicit local empty baselines in the private QA proxy to avoid archive requests for fixture addresses.
Only final qualified, passing runs enter the results table. Initial harness failures are not counted as protocol validation.
limitations: Client and server share one MacBookPro18,3, 16 GiB RAM, 10 logical CPUs; loopback transport, not Wi-Fi or production capacity.
Warm full-state responses, JSON parsing and event fanout are measured; cached HTTP latency is not chain finality.
Actual second-computer LAN access and a real MetaMask approval UI remain unverified while the Mac is locked; Wi-Fi IP requests previously timed out.
Open exposure and payable liabilities are not made solvent by the 5m/day payout cap.
Stress receipts were captured before disposable checkpoint restores; these hashes are not retained as canonical transactions on the live demo.
The source is pinned and the lab oracle/collateral/auth are deliberate replacements; original Papertrade custody is not reproduced.
No quantitative oracle-lag arbitrage, MEV/sandwich or wash-trading-to-PART strategy backtest was performed.

notes: The boundary test artifact retained an older descriptive label mentioning 2000; its measured nextOrder=5002, scanned total=5001 and HTTP 200 are authoritative.
The 200-order measurement was repeated with an explicit wait for all 102 expected positions to reach the canonical index; catch-up was 354.96 ms.
The engine-freeze percentile measurement was corrected and rerun; final values are the directly measured percentiles.
